Primary adrenal insufficiency

Autoimmune destruction of the adrenal cortex is the most common cause in adults.

Patients present with fatigue, hyperpigmentation, and salt craving.

Diagnosis

Low cortisol with elevated ACTH supports the diagnosis. An ACTH stimulation test confirms adrenal insufficiency.

Treatment

Replace glucocorticoids and mineralocorticoids. Unlike secondary adrenal insufficiency, mineralocorticoid replacement is required.
